sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops when any link in the chain is nil
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through a chain of connections, but if any single link is absent, the whole attempt silently resolves to nothing.
sketches.draft:
let you: Person? = nil
let answer = you?.heart?.door?.knock()

sketches.mechanism: The 'object' keyword creates a singleton — exactly one instance can ever exist
sketches.resonance: Declaring something as truly one-of-a-kind is not sentiment but a structural guarantee enforced by the compiler.

sketches.mechanism: A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from the left table even when no match exists on the right, filling absence with NULL
sketches.resonance: One side always shows up, carrying the shape of what was supposed to be beside it, even when nothing is there.
sketches.draft:
SELECT self.day, other.reply
FROM   days   self
LEFT JOIN replies other
ON     self.reaching_out = other.heard
